title: Saro pe qaak udao hai ruqsate shabbir
body:
SARO PE KHAAK UDAAO HAI RUKHSAT-E-SHABBIR
Ye kal ka zikr hai saaman tha moharram mein
Tha dil mein shauq jo tashna labon ke maatam mein
Bichha tha farsh-e-aza jab Hussain ke gham mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajab hai haal magar aaj ahl-e-aalam mein
Khazaa’n nazar mein hai ghar ghar Wida-e-Sarwar se
Gham-o-Alam se hai mehshar Wida-e-Sarwar se
Hai soona soona ye mimbar Wida-e-Sarwar se
<<DIVIDER>>
Dilo pa chalte hai khanjar Wida-e-Sarwar se
Wida-e-Zainab-o-Kulsoom se jigar hai phata
Sakina bibi ka bhi gham hai aur Abid ka
Lahu mein gharkh hai Qasim ke gham mein ahl-e-aza
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthake mashk-o-alam sab hi karte hain girya
Lipatke jhoole se bacche nidhaal hote hain
Jawaa’n Shabi-he-payambar ke gham mein rote hain
Zari-e-Shai pa zayeef apni jaan khote hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Saro ko peet-te ashko se muh ko dhote hain
Uthake taziye chalte the sab hi peero jawaa’n
Tha shauq girya-o-maatam ka ek naya toofaa’n
Imam Bade ki janib the misl Ab-re-rawaa’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Anjuman ye Hussaini ki dekhe ahl-e-aza
Wida-e-Fatima Zehra hai roye’n rulwaye’n
Hussain hi na rahenge to chain kya paaye’n
Udaas taziya khaane hain kaise batlaye’n
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabhi ka nauha hai veera’n gharo’n mein kya jaaye’n
Karenge agle baras phir se majlisen barpa
Lahu ke qatro ne seeno’n se behke dee ye sada
Wafoor-e-Girya se Qasim ye aarahi hai nida
<<DIVIDER>>
Muaaf keejey jo khidmat mein hogayi ho qata
